venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Tuesday 3/24.** Busy-ish Tuesday: first turn dead, then ramped wildly in the second with a few larger parties; closed with several parties still present; never at capacity. Comps $53.90. Top sellers: Masari, First Time Listener/Revenant/Year of the Trees (tie), Material Control. Door: very slow start, rapid pick-up 8:45-10pm with the whole room full; short waitlist, minus walk-ins without physical IDs; first dates, first timers, a 7 top reservation and two walk-in 8s; steady walk-ins until midnight kept the room 3/4 full; welcomed Jacob Rona back with his dad, Emily (formerly Santir), Haleigh with friends, and Gianna. Experiment: not mentioning the 2-hour policy worked well on slower nights; SevenRooms shows each guest's spend. Morgan from Joyface said DOH was around tonight; a handheld was kept outside to send an ELVIS ticket if inspectors came. No no-shows. Kitchen: none. (Door header typed 'Monday 3/24'.)
